function listPosts({url,$}) { return {posts: $("main h2 a").toArray().map(e=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text().trim()})),next:null}; }
function parsePost({url,$}) {const body=$("article").first().clone();body.find('script,style,nav,.post-nav,.post-tag-list,.card:not(.book),.comments').remove();return {title:$("article h1,article h2").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 首頁文章連結 main h2 a；文章標題 article h1,article h2；正文 article，經實際公開首頁和文章 HTML 檢視。
